picks.headline: Gemini task automation expands to 40+ apps, Samsung shows off two more Android XR glasses
picks.excerpt: Google expanded Gemini's on-device task automation to over 40 apps across shopping, restaurant reservations, travel booking and event tickets, debuting on Samsung's new Galaxy Z foldables. The agentic assistant can read on-screen context and complete multi-step actions inside third-party apps without the user hopping between them.
picks.rationale: A concrete agentic capability designers must design around — Gemini now completes multi-step tasks inside 40+ third-party apps on-device, reading on-screen context.

picks.headline: Samsung's latest foldables gain a new way to keep tabs on AI
picks.excerpt: One UI 9 on the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Fold 8 Ultra and Flip 8 introduces a central AI Assistant Activity dashboard, a single place to monitor the background AI automations that Gemini Intelligence performs on your behalf. It is Samsung's attempt to make on-device agentic AI transparent and controllable as assistants start acting autonomously.
picks.rationale: A shipping UX pattern for agent transparency — a dashboard to review and control what autonomous on-device AI did, directly relevant to designing agentic products.

picks.headline: Galaxy Watch 9, Watch Ultra 2 are here: Samsung's health partners bring soft comfort and more
picks.excerpt: Samsung launched the Galaxy Watch 9 and rugged Watch Ultra 2 with new AI-driven health features including a personalized health coach, a Fitness Index, Vascular Load and expanded sleep and heart insights tied to its new AI Health Assistant. The wearables lean on upgraded internals for longer, more accurate on-body monitoring.
picks.rationale: New wearable hardware plus AI-driven health metrics (Fitness Index, Vascular Load, health coach) show how on-body AI coaching gets productized — distinct from the earlier Health Assistant software card.
